description: Plan a road loop whose terrain suits a bike session, as the workout's course panel does: climbs where the intervals are, flat where the recoveries are, from a start point (find_place). By default only plans it and says what it found. send: true also puts the course on the athlete's Garmin beside the workout. Uses their FTP and weight; a session without an FTP on file cannot be turned into a course. Draws a page in the chat — "The course" — so the figures are on screen: refer to what the page shows rather than retyping it, and spend your words on what it means.

athlete_id.description: May be omitted when you coach exactly one athlete.

date.description: The session's date, YYYY-MM-DD — saves reading the whole plan to find it

send.description: Put it on their Garmin. Default false: plan only.

name: plan_course
